5) 흡습의 우려가 있으니 개봉한 제품은 바로 섭취하십시오.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 9.75mg, 비타민 A 420μg, 비타민 B1 0.8mg, 비타민 B2 1.08mg, 비타민 B6 1.28mg, 비타민 C 70mg, 비타민 E 5.5mg, 엽산 175μg

  • 노란색의 원형정제로 이미,이취가 없음 · (주)에스엘에스 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • 나이아신
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 A
    • 어두운 곳에서 시각 적응을 위해 필요
    • 피부와 점막을 형성하고 기능을 유지하는데 필요
    • 상피세포의 성장과 발달에 필요
  • 비타민 B1
    • 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B2
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 B6
    • 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
  • 비타민 C
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요
  • 비타민 E
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 엽산
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
    • 세포와 혈액생성에 필요
    • 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요

이런 분께

  • 매일 나이아신 · 비타민 A · 비타민 B1 · 비타민 B2 · 비타민 B6 · 비타민 C · 비타민 E · 엽산 섭취를 함께 챙기고 싶은 분

Health Functional FoodNiacin 9.75mgVitamin A 420μgVitamin B1 0.8mgVitamin B2 1.08mgVitamin B6 1.28mgVitamin C 70mgVitamin E 5.5mgFolate 175μgOnce a day

종근당건강멀티비타민포맨Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Folate

Made by (주)에스엘에스 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 9.75mg of Niacin, 420μg of Vitamin A, 0.8mg of Vitamin B1, 1.08mg of Vitamin B2, 1.28mg of Vitamin B6, 70mg of Vitamin C, 5.5mg of Vitamin E, 175μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 9.75mg Niacin, 420μg Vitamin A, 0.8mg Vitamin B1, 1.08mg Vitamin B2, 1.28mg Vitamin B6, 70mg Vitamin C, 5.5mg Vitamin E, 175μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)에스엘에스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (9.75mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (420μg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.8mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.08mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.28mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (70mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (5.5mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (175μg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Appearance 노란색의 원형정제로 이미,이취가 없음
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 24개월
Storage 어린이의 손이 닿지 않고, 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Made by (주)에스엘에스 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 9.75mg of Niacin, 350μg of Vitamin A, 0.7mg of Vitamin B1, 0.96mg of Vitamin B2, 1.28mg of Vitamin B6, 80mg of Vitamin C, 6mg of Vitamin E, 212.5μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 9.75mg Niacin, 350μg Vitamin A, 0.7mg Vitamin B1, 0.96mg Vitamin B2, 1.28mg Vitamin B6, 80mg Vitamin C, 6mg Vitamin E, 212.5μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)에스엘에스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
